subject: Quick summary from our call — one question about priority
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Kim <sara.k@clearlinehealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Quick summary from our call — one question about priority

Hi Sara,

Thanks again for taking 25 minutes today — really helpful to learn about Clearline's plans for more patient-facing automation. Quick, high-level summary from our side so the team is aligned: 

• Current environment: HIPAA-guardrails + private VPC; you mentioned latency spikes on end-of-day reports and high inference costs on conversational flows.
• How Redwood helps: Dedicated GPU pools for predictable p99 latency, KV-prefix caching and inference batching to cut unit token cost, and a private control plane option for your compliance needs.
• Pilot idea (minimal): 2-week dedicated-capacity pilot for a single model endpoint (baseline metrics + 2 optimizations: caching + quantized weights).

I attached a one-pager that sketches the pilot and expected signals we measure (latency, tokens/unit cost, error rates).

One quick question for your planning team: where does work on model-serving/inference sit on your roadmap for the next 60 days — would you categorize it as high / medium / low priority? If it's high, I can coordinate a 30-minute technical scoping call next week with our infra engineer to map scope and timeline. If it's not a near-term priority, no problem — we can set a reminder to circle back next quarter.

Proposed next steps:
- Reply with priority (high/medium/low)
- If high: suggest 2x 30-min slots and I'll send a calendar invite

Thanks,

Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0149

Attachments: discovery-one-pager.pdf (PDF, ~1.2MB)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Kim <sara.k@clearlinehealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Aug 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick summary from our call — one question about priority

Hi Sara —

Just looping back on this note in case it got buried. I know priorities shift quickly; if you have a quick thumbs up or down on priority that would be super helpful so we know whether to engage engineering time.

If it helps, here are two 30-min windows I can offer next week for a technical scoping call:
- Tue 9/7, 10:00–10:30am PT
- Wed 9/8, 2:30–3:00pm PT

If neither works, tell me what does and I’ll coordinate. Otherwise I’ll check back in a few weeks.

Thanks — appreciate it,

Tessa

Date: Mon, 06 Sep 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick summary from our call — one question about priority

Hi Tessa —

Thanks for the follow up and for the one-pager. We had an internal planning sync last week and decided to deprioritize large inference platform work until after our Q4 compliance audits. That puts this initiative in a lower priority bucket for the next 3–4 months.

I appreciate the pilot outline — it looks sensible — but we don't have the cycles to run a pilot right now. Let's keep the HubSpot record open and revisit in early February. Please ping me then; if anything changes on our end sooner I'll reach out.

Best,

Sara Kim
Director of Engineering
Clearline Health
sara.k@clearlinehealth.com
